title: HAWK + GoHighLevel Power Dialer Workflow Build Pack
instructions: Open the matching existing GoHighLevel workflow, then paste only that workflow's aiPrompt into its Workflow AI editor.
Every aiPrompt is an in-place edit request. Do not create, clone, duplicate, or rename workflows.
Do not add a GoHighLevel AI Agent, GPT action, custom code, or third-party app action.
Use native GoHighLevel triggers, filters, tag actions, custom-field actions, Wait actions, Manual Call actions, DND actions, and Webhook POST actions only.
The two webhook triggers and connections are already working. Preserve their current endpoint URLs, methods, Authorization headers, secrets, and enrollment settings.
Keep Allow Multiple disabled unless the workflow explicitly states otherwise.
Test with a non-production contact before publishing.

deploymentPlaceholders.HAWK_ELIGIBILITY_WEBHOOK_URL: Paste the URL generated by HAWK flow Call Center - OWL Eligibility and Pool Routing
deploymentPlaceholders.HAWK_ELIGIBILITY_SECRET: Paste the one-time secret generated with the eligibility endpoint
deploymentPlaceholders.HAWK_OUTCOME_WEBHOOK_URL: Paste the URL generated by HAWK flow Call Center - Manual Call Outcome Router
deploymentPlaceholders.HAWK_OUTCOME_SECRET: Paste the one-time secret generated with the outcome endpoint

tagDictionary.cc-recheck: Request a fresh authoritative HAWK eligibility decision
tagDictionary.hawk-dialer-ready: HAWK currently approves the contact for Manual Actions
tagDictionary.cc-outcome-submit: Submit the current Call_outcome field to HAWK
tagDictionary.cc-await-callback: Wait until CC Next Call At
tagDictionary.cc-dial-blocked: OWL rejected or could not verify eligibility

workflows.name: CC 01 - Send Eligibility Signal to HAWK
workflows.purpose: Convert the cc-recheck tag into an authenticated HAWK execution.

webhookPayloadContract.contactId: Select the native Contact ID merge field
webhookPayloadContract.name: Select the native Contact Full Name merge field

workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 01 - Send Eligibility Signal to HAWK'. Preserve the existing cc-recheck trigger, enrollment settings, and working HAWK webhook connection exactly as configured. Do not recreate or replace the trigger or Webhook action. Locate the existing Webhook action named 'Run HAWK OWL Eligibility' and preserve its current POST URL, Authorization header, secret, and standard contact-data setting. Only edit its Custom Data mappings. Under Custom Data add exactly these four keys: eventName with fixed text call_center.eligibility; contactId mapped with the native Contact ID merge field; name mapped with the native Contact Full Name merge field; serviceType mapped with contact custom field service_type, field ID 04r14svrWH36Knji7YcY. The values for contactId, name, and serviceType must be inserted with GoHighLevel's field picker, not typed as literal example text. Do not use the Services field ID uO4QvsQSGHBM4Vh48v0L because it is boolean. Do not add delays, AI actions, custom code, or CRM mutations. Save and leave Draft until a test returns HTTP 202 with accepted true.

workflows.name: CC 02 - Submit Manual Call Outcome to HAWK
workflows.purpose: Send the rep-selected Call_outcome value into HAWK after a Manual Call task is completed.

webhookPayloadContract.contactId: Select the native Contact ID merge field
webhookPayloadContract.name: Select the native Contact Full Name merge field
webhookPayloadContract.nextCallAt: Select contact custom field CC Next Call At (HvxGHlgSy1tdJ4PLnVGG)

workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 02 - Submit Manual Call Outcome to HAWK'. Preserve the existing cc-outcome-submit trigger, enrollment settings, and working HAWK webhook connection exactly as configured. Do not recreate or replace the trigger or Webhook action. Locate the existing Webhook action named 'Submit Call Outcome to HAWK' and preserve its current POST URL, Authorization header, secret, and standard contact-data setting. Only edit its Custom Data mappings. Under Custom Data add exactly these six keys: eventName with fixed text call_center.outcome; contactId mapped with the native Contact ID merge field; name mapped with the native Contact Full Name merge field; callOutcome mapped with contact custom field Call_outcome, ID IfwpWY8S2SPsrvefs72j; nextCallAt mapped with contact custom field CC Next Call At, ID HvxGHlgSy1tdJ4PLnVGG; servicePool mapped with contact custom field service_type, ID 04r14svrWH36Knji7YcY. Insert every dynamic value with GoHighLevel's field picker and do not type example values literally. Do not remove cc-outcome-submit in this workflow; HAWK removes it only after accepting the webhook. Do not clear Call_outcome here; HAWK clears it after the Call Center record is created. Leave Draft until the webhook test returns HTTP 202 with accepted true, then publish.

workflows.name: CC 10 - Roofing Power Dialer
workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 10 - Roofing Power Dialer'. Trigger when Contact Tag Added includes cc-pool-roofing. Add filters requiring tag hawk-dialer-ready and excluding contacts with cc-dnc, cc-not-interested, cc-scheduled, cc-invalid, cc-converted-sale, cc-closed-won, cc-closed-lost, cc-dnq, or cc-dial-blocked. Disable Allow Multiple. Locate the existing Manual Call action named 'Roofing Power Dialer Call'. Set Assign To User to the contact custom value {{contact.assigned_dialer}}. Preserve that dynamic value exactly. Do not use the contact owner, a fixed user, round robin, or assignment branches in GHL; HAWK assigns the dialer before adding the pool tag. After the Manual Call action, add tag cc-outcome-submit. Add an internal note in the workflow description: the rep must set contact custom field Call_outcome to exactly No Answer, Voicemail, Follow Up, Requested Appointment, Not Interested, Incorrect Number, or No Longer At Address before deleting the Manual Call task. Do not add automatic SMS, email, AI, or another call action.

workflows.name: CC 20 - No Answer Retry Scheduler
workflows.purpose: Recheck a no-answer contact after a controlled cooldown; OWL decides whether another attempt is legal.
workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 20 - No Answer Retry Scheduler'. Trigger when Contact Tag Added includes cc-await-retry. Allow Multiple only after the contact has exited the previous run. Wait 24 hours. Then remove tag cc-await-retry and add tag cc-recheck. Do not directly add a pool tag or hawk-dialer-ready. Do not create a Manual Call action here. HAWK must make the new DNC, assignment, appointment, hours, and attempt-limit decision.

workflows.name: CC 21 - Requested Callback Scheduler
workflows.purpose: Return requested callbacks to OWL at the rep-selected time.
workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 21 - Requested Callback Scheduler'. Trigger when Contact Tag Added includes cc-await-callback. First branch on custom field CC Next Call At, ID HvxGHlgSy1tdJ4PLnVGG. If it is empty, remove cc-await-callback, add cc-outcome-review, and end. If it has a value, wait until that exact contact date/time, then remove cc-await-callback and add cc-recheck. Do not directly queue a Manual Call; HAWK must re-evaluate eligibility first.

workflows.name: CC 30 - Appointment Safeguard
workflows.purpose: Remove newly scheduled contacts from all Power Dialer sources.
workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 30 - Appointment Safeguard'. Trigger when an appointment is created or its status becomes new or confirmed. Update contact custom field Call_outcome, ID IfwpWY8S2SPsrvefs72j, to the exact value scheduled. Add tag cc-outcome-submit. Do not add a Manual Call action. This causes HAWK to remove all active pool tags and mark the contact scheduled.

workflows.name: CC 31 - DNC Safeguard
workflows.purpose: Apply native DND and remove a contact from dialing when the rep selects DNC.
workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 31 - DNC Safeguard'. Trigger when contact custom field Call_outcome, ID IfwpWY8S2SPsrvefs72j, changes to the exact value dnc. Use the native GoHighLevel DND action to enable Do Not Disturb for the Call channel and SMS channel. Then add tag cc-outcome-submit. Do not add any outbound communication or Manual Call action.

workflows.name: CC 40 - Won Sale Queue Removal
workflows.purpose: Permanently remove converted sales from all calling pools.
workflows.aiPrompt: This is an edit request, not a creation request. Modify only the currently open existing GoHighLevel workflow named 'CC 40 - Won Sale Queue Removal'. Trigger when an opportunity status changes to Won in the production sales pipeline. Remove tags cc-recheck, hawk-dialer-ready, cc-pool-roofing, cc-pool-mold, cc-pool-solar, cc-pool-kitchen, cc-pool-bathroom, cc-pool-home-addition, cc-await-retry, cc-await-callback, cc-outcome-submit, and cc-dial-blocked. Add tag cc-converted-sale. Update contact custom field Dialer Status, ID VsXb7HofKxm6F5sr7edH, to CLOSED - WON SALE. Do not create another opportunity or Manual Call action.

agentOperatingRule: A Manual Call action does not advance until the task is deleted from Conversations > Manual Actions. The rep must select and save Call_outcome before deleting the task. The next workflow step then adds cc-outcome-submit, which invokes HAWK.
